brief.purpose: Show a shipped enemy line written as one design sheet.
brief.home: worked example; the enemy itself already ships

concept.hook: A warband whose rungs each do one blunt job.

line.name: The Verge
line.premise: A warband rather than an organisation; nobody in it hides what they do.

rungs.name: Prowler
rungs.combat_role: A fast, thin skirmisher that works at range and is met two or three at a time.
rungs.tactical_read: Close the distance: its only short-range strike is its weakest tool.
rungs.notes: Kit, level and behaviour are as recorded in building-tnr-content/references/lines.md. Role and generals are not recorded there, so they stay open. The recorded stat anchor cannot be written on a sheet yet (see references/libraries.md, limits).

rungs.name: Breaker
rungs.combat_role: A slow, heavy bruiser that pins a player in place and then hits hard.
rungs.tactical_read: Keep moving and stay outside range 3, where its pin cannot reach.
rungs.notes: Kit, level and behaviour are as recorded in building-tnr-content/references/lines.md. Role and generals are not recorded there, so they stay open. The recorded stat anchor cannot be written on a sheet yet (see references/libraries.md, limits).

rungs.name: Warband Captain
rungs.combat_role: A support leader that strengthens its allies and marks a target for them.
rungs.tactical_read: Defeat the Captain first; the fight gets harder each round it stands.
rungs.notes: Kit, level and behaviour are as recorded in building-tnr-content/references/lines.md. Role and generals are not recorded there, and the page says only that Second Wind fires below a health threshold, so all three stay open. The recorded stat anchor cannot be written on a sheet yet.
